meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Adorable Cottage! * 400 Yards to Beach Access At the End of The Street* 2 Pools, Hot Tub, Walking Bridges and Fishable Lake* Located in Seagrove Beach Minutes Away from Some of the Best Dining on 30A* Walk to Cafe 30A, The Perfect Pig, or Doug
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Adorable Cottage! * 400 Yards to Beach Access At the End of The Street* 2 Pools, Hot Tub, Walking Bridges and Fishable Lake* Located in Seagrove Beach Minutes Away from Some of the Best Dining on 30A* Walk to Cafe 30A, The Perfect Pig, or Dough Sea Dough* Nearby Greenway Station - NEW Summer 2023!* Less Than 2 Miles to Seaside* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service**This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.***Though this unit has sleeping arrangements for 6, the sleep count is limited to 4**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to a 30A beach experience! Seagrove Bungalow 153 is a 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath cottage in The Bungalows at Seagrove just 400 yards from beach access. This adorable two story cottage offers a bright, open floor plan with a fully equipped kitchen featuring new stainless steel appliances. With a king in each bedroom on the second floor, plus a queen sleeper sofa in the living room on the first floor, this lovely cottage comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests. There is also a half-bath which includes a linen closet with a stackable washer/dryer for additional convenience. Chase the sunset from the balcony, which you can access from either bedroom and you will love having the pool just steps away. Come make Seagrove Bungalow 153 a family vacation tradition for years to come!The Bed Setup: Main Floor:Living Room: w/ Queen Sleep sofa2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King Bed Bungalows at Seagrove is a planned bungalow community of 56 individual 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath homes in Seagrove Beach, less than 2 miles east of Seaside, on Highway 30-A. It is walking distance to bike, golf cart, kayak rentals and stores to purchase beach essentials. If you forgot or need something it is a 4 minute walk to Tom Thumb Convenience Store. You can also walk to Goatfeathers Seafood Market for their fresh seafood, steamed shrimp, smoked tuna dip and more. This well appointed planned community is within walking distance of the beach and includes 2 pools, a hot tub, masterfully landscaped grounds with an adjoining lake, abundant parking spaces, and sidewalks, with numerous wooden walk bridges.Area Attractions:Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. Greenway station is 30A's newest destination for gathering, shopping, and dining in Seagrove Beach. Greenway Station features known retailers Wild Olives Tapas and Wine Bar, Pecan Jack's Ice Cream, Coast Hippie and YOLO Board + Bike, plus introduces Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Café, and more.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
